P.text: When adding a new order that introduces a new limit/price queue and the worst price limit queue has more than one order
P.evidence_quote: For cases where the worst price limit queue has more than one order, the limit will not be removed and if the new order being added introduces a new limit/price queue

I.text: Non competitive orders should be removed once maxNumLimitsPerSide is reached, keeping the side's tree at the intended size
I.evidence_quote: Clob orderBooks have a `maxNumLimitsPerSide` from which on addition of new orders, the non competive orders should be removed.

V.text: The check `ds.askTree.size() == maxNumLimitsPerSide` returns false, so the least competitive price order is not removed and maxNumLimitsPerSide is exceeded
V.evidence_quote: the `maxNumLimitsPerSide` variable will be exceeded and the check  of `ds.askTree.size() == maxNumLimitsPerSide)` will return false hence the least competitive price order will not be removed from the orderBook while it should be.
